subject: Pricing approvals needed — Q3 forecast integrity & commit escrow (Nebula Systems)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Action needed — pricing approvals blocking Q3 commit for Nebula Systems

Team,

Heads-up: Nebula Systems has two pending opportunities that are currently stuck in the pricing gate and are materially impacting our Q3 committed numbers if we don't resolve them this week. Finance is asking for a clear decision so we can mark the deals appropriately in the forecast.

Quick summary (deal IDs in HubSpot):
- NEB-1423 — Pilot + SLA add-on; list price $250k ARR; sales proposed 8% concession to win (attached pricing_sheet_Nebula_v2.xlsx).
- NEB-1427 — Renewal upsell for analytics seats; list price $95k ARR; sales requested 10% concession tied to a 36-month term.

Request: Deal Desk + Finance — please review NEB-1423 and NEB-1427 and confirm approval or counter parameters by 2027-08-02 EOD. If we need an exception path, flag required approver and ETA.

Why this matters: These two deals combined move our Q3 committed number by ~$270k ARR. If pricing exceptions are not approved, we must move NEB-1423 to "best case" for forecasting, which would create a visible hole on the weekly forecast and will trigger follow-ups from the CFO.

Attachments: pricing_sheet_Nebula_v2.xlsx (pricing worksheet with proposed concession matrix).
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/NEB-1423

Proposed short plan:
- Deal Desk to confirm concession ceiling (no later than 2027-08-02)
- Finance to indicate whether we can treat NEB-1423 as committed conditional on signed SOW by 2027-08-05 (escrow notes in HubSpot).

Marissa / Ben / Marcus — can one of you own the first-pass decision? Vanessa — if you can flag any finance constraints (e.g., revenue recognition concerns) that would be great.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0182

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action needed — pricing approvals blocking Q3 commit for Nebula Systems

Thanks for the flag, Rafael.

Short answers / next steps from Deal Desk perspective:
- For NEB-1423: 8% concession is within our standard scope for pilots, but we need a short justification note (customer ROI + committed seat baseline). If Marketing or CSM can sign off, we can approve up to 10% under deal desk authority.
- For NEB-1427: 10% tied to 36 months needs Deal Desk + RevOps sign-off. That's outside standard delegated limits.

Questions:
1) Rafael — is the 8% in NEB-1423 a one-time discount, or does it apply to the ARR baseline (affects ARR forecast)?
2) Marcus — can you confirm SOW timeline and whether legal will accept our standard term addendum or if redlines are imminent?

I'll start a quick approval ticket and tag RevOps for NEB-1427. If we get a short-term escrow or signed SOW by Aug 5 we can mark NEB-1423 as "committed" in the forecast with a conditional note.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@nebulasys.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Contracts <contracts@nebulasys.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 10:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing approvals blocking Q3 commit for Nebula Systems

Hi Rafael,

Appreciate the transparency. We're hoping to close NEB-1423 this week — our execs have a vendor decision on Aug 6 and a signed SOW by Aug 10 is ideal (we need the analytics pilot to start Aug 15).

We can accept a 6% concession if Redwood is willing to commit to the pilot start date in writing and include a 1-year renewal price cap in the SOW. That helps us justify the spend to procurement. If you can get a short term agreement or a DocuSign route by Aug 5, we'll sign.

I'll loop Contracts and our CFO to speed review: Contracts <contracts@nebulasys.com>.

Thanks,
Lara Chen
VP Product, Nebula Systems
lara.chen@nebulasys.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@nebulasys.com>, Contracts <contracts@nebulasys.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Aug 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action needed — pricing approvals blocking Q3 commit for Nebula Systems

Team — quick update and proposed decision path.

Decision (proposal):
- Approve NEB-1423 concession at 6% (counter to customer's 6% ask) conditional on:
  - Signed SOW with 1-year renewal price cap (redline attached: redlined_SOW_Nebula.pdf)
  - DocuSign executed by 2027-08-05
  - Finance marks NEB-1423 as "committed (conditional)" in the forecast with a note referencing the DocuSign ETA and concession amount.

- NEB-1427 to remain in "best case" until RevOps signs off on 36-month concession. Deal Desk to open formal RevOps approval ticket (Ben).

If no objections by 17:00 PT today, I'll proceed to route the redlined SOW and DocuSign request to Nebula Contracts. Vanessa — can you confirm we can treat "committed (conditional)" revenue the way I outlined for the weekly forecast (revenue recognition team is okay with the conditional flag)?

Attachments: redlined_SOW_Nebula.pdf, pricing_sheet_Nebula_v2.xlsx
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/NEB-1423
Approval ticket (Deal Desk): https://ops.company/approvals/NEB-1423

Thanks all — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0182
